## Units Sold by Region

| Region | Units Sold (Quantity) |
|----------|----------------------:|
| West     | 62                    |
| South    | 53                    |
| North    | 40                    |
| East     | 28                    |

**Total: 183 units across all 43 orders.**

### Problems found & fixes applied
- **Region label variants (6 cells):** The Region column had case variants (`north`, `east`) and misspellings (`Nort`, `Suoth`, `Wst`). These were merged into the canonical labels `North`, `South`, `East`, `West` per the rules file. Without this fix, these rows would have formed spurious separate "regions" and undercounted the real ones.
- **Quantity column:** Clean — numeric, all positive whole numbers, no missing values. No fix needed.
- **Price/Revenue columns:** These have text formatting (e.g. `$350.00`, `$6.00`) and some values don't satisfy `Revenue = Quantity * Price`, but the question only asks about units sold (Quantity), so these were left untouched.

### Caveats
- All numbers come from the `analyze` tool result.
- The Region normalization was the only change made; the original data file was not modified (fixes run on a copy).
